name: refusal-message-double-read-and-direct-display
body: `refusal_message` evaluates freshness twice (the `is_stale` gate, then `freshness_differences` for the labels), and its recorded half still uses the direct `db_recorded_scan` rather than the routed read. Because a live session owns `db.lbug` exclusively, that direct read takes the None branch on every live-session refusal — the mutation gate's normal path — so it prints `-@-` while the differing list came from the routed read (pre-existing, benign today). Upgrade by routing the display read or folding the gate and list into one evaluation only if the pairing is made a contract or refusal latency shows in a profile.
